Hi Lydia —

Thanks for starting the onboarding packet. I pulled the documents your team uploaded (Composite_W9_2028-03-20.pdf) into the procurement intake. Finance flagged a mismatch between the legal entity name on the W-9 and the EIN we see in the IRS lookup — looks like a DBA/doing-business-as variation. Before we can move the vendor into the purchase account and issue a PO, tax compliance needs one of the following to resolve the discrepancy:

- IRS CP 575 or EIN confirmation letter, OR
- State business registration showing the DBA linkage to the EIN, OR
- Bank letter showing the legal entity name and account (signed on bank letterhead).

Also, procurement needs the signatory name/authority for the SOW (DocuSign link below). Can you confirm: 1) the legal/entity name that should appear on the PO, and 2) whether the attached W-9 was signed by the authorized signer on file with the bank?

We can provisionally open a PO in the system with restricted payment terms (payment hold until tax clearance) to avoid blocking the SOW delivery, but we need to confirm the evidence and authorized signer to proceed.

Proc ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4789

If you can send one of the documents above by end of tomorrow PDT we’ll prioritize the PO pathing.

Thanks,

Ethan / Monica —

Thanks for the note, Ethan, and thanks Lydia for the quick reply. For tax-compliance clearance we typically accept one of the following to reconcile a legal name vs DBA issue:

1) IRS CP 575 or official EIN confirmation letter (preferred)
2) Bank letter on bank letterhead with account number and legal entity name (signed by an authorized bank rep)
3) State business filing linking DBA to the legal entity (certificate of assumed name or filing showing both names)
4) If none of the above are available immediately, a notarized affidavit from an officer tying the DBA to the legal name plus a provisional deposit test may be used (last resort).

Operationally we can:
- Open a provisional PO with a payment hold (Escrow/Hold until Clearance) so engineering/vendor onboarding isn't blocked, OR
- Defer PO creation until we receive CP 575 / bank letter and then fast-track the PO with standard Net 30/45 terms.

Please attach whichever doc Lydia can send — CP 575 is fastest. I added our Vendor_KBA_Checklist.xlsx to the PROC ticket so treasury has the checklist for KBA/AML steps. Also confirm the signer's name on the bank letter matches Jordan Lin.

Kimberly Park
Manager, Vendor Onboarding & Payments
